title: Daily Damages Amount Where the Building Carries an Energy Subscription
content:
# Daily Damages Amount Where the Building Carries an Energy Subscription

A late changeover costs an owner more where the building's consumption is being measured against a commitment, and the daily amount of damages on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects follows that.

## Rule

Where one of the Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions covers the building and its class carries a guaranteed savings commitment, the daily amount is the daily amount the project's class carries together with the measured performance addition of **USD 450 per day**.

Where one of the Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions covers the building and its class carries no guaranteed savings commitment, the daily amount is the daily amount the project's class carries together with the metering addition of **USD 150 per day**.

Where no energy subscription covers the building, the daily amount is the daily amount the project's class carries.

## What is read

The subscription read is the one standing at the same building, and what is read of it is whether its class is written with a guaranteed savings commitment. A subscription covering the building whose class carries no such commitment takes the second case, never the third; the third case is for a building carrying no subscription at all.

| Energy subscription at the building | Its class carries a guaranteed savings commitment | Added to the class's daily amount |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | USD 450 per day |
| yes | no | USD 150 per day |
| no | — | nothing |

## Worked amounts (hypothetical, project class daily amount of USD 1200)

With a subscription carrying a savings commitment the daily amount is USD 1650; with a subscription carrying none it is USD 1350; with no subscription at the building it is USD 1200.
